hero.title: Academic Excellence at Your Fingertips
hero.text: Universite ZTF's SCKOLARIS digital library is the intellectual heart of our institution. Dedicated to supporting research, teaching, and learning, it offers seamless access to thousands of rigorously curated academic resources.

local.title: Local Roots, Global Vision
local.text: Located in Bertoua, Universite ZTF is committed to raising the level of education in the region while connecting our students to international academic standards. SCKOLARIS is the tool that removes geographic barriers, giving our researchers access to knowledge from around the world.

access.title: Accessibility
access.text: Making academic resources available 24/7 for all our students.

quality.title: Quality
quality.text: Ensuring the rigor and relevance of the books and publications offered.

community.title: Community
community.text: Bringing researchers and students together around a shared learning space.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.controllerText: The controller responsible for processing personal data collected on SCKOLARIS is Institut Universitaire ZTF, Bertoua, Cameroon. For any question about your data: <mail>biblio@iu-ztf.cm</mail> [TO BE COMPLETED: data protection officer contact, if applicable].
privacy.accountData: Account data: first name, last name, registration number, email address, password (never stored in plain text, only hashed), role (student, teacher, administrator).
privacy.usageData: Usage data: download history, personal library, deposits made — necessary for the platform's features to work (cross-device synchronization, history).
privacy.browsingData: Browsing data: only if you have given your consent via the cookie banner (see section 4).
privacy.purpose1: Providing access to the account and platform features;
privacy.purpose2: Ensuring account security and preventing fraudulent use;
privacy.purpose3: Synchronizing your personal library across your devices;
privacy.purpose4: Measuring, in an aggregated and anonymous way, platform usage — only if you have consented to it.
privacy.cookiesText1: SCKOLARIS uses cookies and similar technologies strictly necessary for the site to function (keeping your login session active): these do not require consent.
privacy.cookiesText2: A banner also lets you accept or decline anonymized audience measurement (usage statistics, with no individual identification), provided by a privacy-respecting service that does not set advertising tracking cookies and does not resell any data to third parties. You can change your choice at any time by clearing this site's browsing data in your browser: the consent banner will reappear on your next visit.
privacy.retentionText: Account data is kept for the entire duration of your enrollment at Universite ZTF, then archived or deleted in accordance with applicable legal obligations. You may request deletion of your account at any time.
privacy.recipientsText: Your data is only accessible to authorized Universite ZTF staff (platform administrators) and to our technical hosting providers (Railway, Vercel — see the <legal>legal notice</legal>), strictly to the extent necessary for the service to function. It is never sold, rented, or shared with third parties for commercial purposes.
privacy.securityText: Exchanges with the platform are encrypted (HTTPS). Passwords are stored in hashed form and are never accessible in plain text, even by the technical team.
privacy.rightsText: You have the right to access, rectify, and delete your personal data. To exercise it, contact <mail>biblio@iu-ztf.cm</mail> or use the <contact>contact form</contact>.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.purposeText: These terms govern the use of the SCKOLARIS platform, the digital library of Institut Universitaire ZTF , accessible via the website, the mobile app, and the desktop app. By creating an account or using the platform, you unreservedly accept these terms.
terms.accessText1: Access to full features (download, deposit) is reserved for Universite ZTF students, teachers, and staff with a validated account. A newly created account remains in "pending" status until validated by a teacher or an administrator.
terms.accessText2: You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential and for any activity carried out from your account. Any suspicion of unauthorized use must be reported immediately to <mail>biblio@iu-ztf.cm</mail>.
terms.catalogUseText1: The catalog is made available strictly for educational purposes and personal research. Online reading and downloading of documents are for individual use only; any redistribution, resale, or public sharing of a downloaded document, outside the exceptions provided by copyright law, is prohibited.
terms.catalogUseText2: Documents downloaded for offline reading remain tied to your account and are stored locally on your devices (browser, mobile app, or desktop app); they are accessible only to you.
terms.depositText: Teachers authorized to deposit course materials guarantee that they hold the necessary rights to the deposited content (personal work, author's authorization, or public domain work) and bear full responsibility for it. Universite ZTF reserves the right to remove, without notice, any content reported as infringing a third party's rights, and to process deletion requests according to the procedure provided in the administrator dashboard.
terms.prohibited1: Attempting to bypass authentication or authorization mechanisms;
terms.prohibited2: Mass-extracting catalog content by automated means;
terms.prohibited3: Depositing unlawful, defamatory content, or content infringing a third party's rights;
terms.availabilityText: Universite ZTF strives to ensure continuous access to the platform but does not guarantee uninterrupted availability. Temporary interruptions may occur for maintenance or for reasons beyond its control.
terms.suspensionText: Any breach of these terms may result in the suspension or deletion of the account concerned, without prejudice to any potential legal action.
terms.changesText: These terms may be changed at any time; the last update date appears at the top of this page. Continued use of the platform after a change constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
terms.lawText: These terms are governed by Cameroonian law. Any dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the courts of Bertoua, Cameroon.

cookieConsent.text: We'd like to anonymously measure SCKOLARIS's traffic to improve it — no personal data, never resold to third parties. You can accept or decline at any time; this never affects your access to the platform. <link>Learn more</link>
